meeting.title: Clinic relocation weekly sync
attendees: Call-in user 2 (introduced as Ah Hock from facilities)

summary.text: The movers quoted $42,000, which is $12,000 over the move budget. It is the first quote, not a final price.

quotes.text: The movers quote came in at forty two thousand dollars, which is twelve thousand over what we budgeted for the move.
It's the quote we have so uh far. Nothing is final.

summary.text: Priya said the team should not use contingency for the overrun this early in the project.

quotes.text: we don't want to dip into contingency for this. It's far too early in the project to be spending that.

summary.text: The quote prices weekend overtime for the whole job. Moving the non-clinical rooms on a weekday should lower it, but nobody knows how much those rooms cost or whether the movers will split the job.

quotes.text: They priced weekend overtime um for the whole job. If we move the non-clinical rooms on a weekday it should drop.
honestly I don't have that split yet. It's why I think we need them to price it again.
so that's an open question, whether they'll price it that way.

actions.text: Get a revised movers quote with the weekday and weekend parts shown separately.

quotes.text: Marcus, please get a revised quote with the weekday split by Friday the fourth.
I'll ask them to sort of show the weekday and weekend parts separately

summary.text: The vendor's own engineers at Radix Imaging must move and recalibrate the X-ray machine. The general movers will not do it.

quotes.text: The X-ray machine has to be moved and recalibrated by the vendor's own engineers, Radix Imaging.

summary.text: Radix engineers are booked out for most of February, so the team may not get a slot before the cutover. This came from a conversation and is not a firm no.

quotes.text: Their engineers are booked out most of February, so there's a chance we don't get a slot before the cutover.
It was a conversation. I wouldn't call it a firm no.

summary.text: If imaging is not ready on day one, patients would have to go to the old site, which defeats the purpose of the move.

quotes.text: If imaging isn't ready on day one we'd have to send patients to the old site, which defeats the purpose.

actions.text: Ask Radix to hold two provisional dates and report back.

quotes.text: I'll ask Radix to hold two provisional dates for us, and I'll come back next week.

summary.text: The healthcare licence must be transferred to the new address before any patient is seen there.

quotes.text: The healthcare licence has to be transferred to the new address before we see any patient there.

summary.text: The plan assumes the ministry will process the transfer within six weeks of filing. The regulator has not promised this.

quotes.text: Our plan assumes the ministry processes like the transfer within six weeks of us filing it.
It's what our plan assumes, and I'm not going to dress it up as more than that.

summary.text: The transfer has not been filed yet. It will be filed once the floor plan is final, expected next Monday, and the six weeks start from filing.

quotes.text: Not yet, we file once the floor plan is final, which should be next Monday.
The clock begins when we file.

summary.text: Fit-out of the treatment rooms cannot start until the landlord hands over level five. The landlord has said the fifteenth of January.

quotes.text: We can't start the fit-out of the treatment rooms until the landlord hands over level five, and they've said basically the fifteenth of January.

summary.text: The date was given mostly on a call and is not firm. The follow-up message did not repeat it.

quotes.text: Mostly on a call. I did get a short message afterwards but it didn't really repeat the date.

summary.text: This is a hard stop because there is no access to the level before handover, so everything from the treatment rooms onwards depends on this date.

quotes.text: It's a hard stop as far as I understand it. We don't have access to the level I mean until they hand it over.
So everything from the treatment rooms onwards hangs on that date.

actions.text: Get the handover date in writing from the landlord's property manager.

quotes.text: Yeah, I'll get the handover date kind of in writing from their property manager.
I'm chasing the written handover date.

summary.text: There were two options: the thirteenth and fourteenth of February, or the weekend after.

quotes.text: We said either the thirteenth and fourteenth of sort of February or the week after.

summary.text: The weekend after clashes with the school holidays, when about half the nurses are on leave.

quotes.text: The basically week after clashes with the school holidays, half the nurses are on leave.

summary.text: Decision: the cutover weekend is the thirteenth and fourteenth of February, and everyone agreed. This assumes the handover date of the fifteenth of January holds.

quotes.text: decision: the cutover weekend is the thirteenth and fourteenth of February. Everyone okay?
If the handover date moves, then we'd need to look at things again.
